orange-tee.jpg.verdict: Worth buying only if you want colour, since it is a basic tee like the one you already own. It is cheap to wear and mixes easily, but it does not fill a real wardrobe gap.
orange-tee.jpg.gap: It adds a warm burnt orange and a boxier, cropped shape to a closet that is all black, blue and tan. The black tee covers the same kind of item in a different colour and fit, so the overlap is partial and the main gain is colour and proportion.

outfits.name: Easy summer day
outfits.reason: Orange against light blue denim is a simple warm-weather pairing, and the straw hat and black sneakers keep it relaxed.

outfits.name: Layered casual
outfits.reason: The mid blue chore jacket over the orange tee gives a workwear look, and the tan backpack suits the earthy tone. Black sneakers ground it.

outfits.name: Weekend outdoors
outfits.reason: Tan, straw and orange sit in the same warm range, so this reads as a cohesive outdoor outfit without needing outerwear.

striped-shirt.jpg.verdict: Worth buying if you want something smarter than a plain tee. Your closet is all casual, and this shirt is the only piece that moves toward smart casual.
striped-shirt.jpg.gap: The only other top is a black tee, which is plain, short-sleeved and casual, so the striped shirt adds a long-sleeve, collared, patterned option. Your closet still has no trousers or smarter shoes, which limits how dressy it can look.

outfits.name: Casual summer day
outfits.reason: Wear the shirt untucked with sleeves rolled up over the light denim shorts. The black suede sneakers and straw hat keep it relaxed.

outfits.name: Layered workwear
outfits.reason: The stripes sit well under the mid blue chore jacket. The tan backpack adds a practical, outdoorsy touch. Mixing two denim washes works because they are clearly different.

boots.jpg.verdict: Worth buying if you want something smarter or cooler-weather than your skate sneakers. It fills a real gap, though you'll need a longer pair of trousers to get the most out of it.
boots.jpg.gap: Your only shoes are casual black suede skate sneakers, so the boots add a polished leather option and a smart-casual step up. The sneakers share the black colour but differ in material, style and formality, so this is partial overlap and not a duplicate.

outfits.name: Casual summer boots
outfits.reason: Black tee and distressed shorts with the boots give a relaxed look with some edge. The fedora's black band ties in with the boots.

outfits.name: Workwear layers
outfits.reason: The denim jacket and tan backpack suit the rugged leather boots. It's a sturdy everyday outfit, though denim on denim with shorts is very casual.
